resources.string: Needed for Android older than 7.0 (API 24). Keep it on unless the app\'s minSdk is 24 or higher.
Whole-APK signature (Android 7.0+). Required for apps targeting Android 11+: turned on automatically for them when v2 and v3 are both off.
v3 (APK Signature Scheme v3, key rotation)
Adds key rotation support (Android 9+). Also satisfies the Android 11+ requirement on its own, but only installs on Android 9+ without v1/v2.
v4 (APK Signature Scheme v4, .idsig for incremental install)
Writes <apk>.idsig next to the APK, used by \"adb install --incremental\" (Android 11+). Requires v2 or v3: v2 is turned on if both are off.
